title: Align before Fuse: Vision and Language Representation Learning with Momentum Distillation
layout_note: Image encoder (left) and text encoder (right) stand side by side on the input line; the contrastive loss sits between them; the multimodal encoder rises above the text encoder with its two heads (ITM, MLM) on top. A momentum model sits outside the main frame on the right.
grouping: One pale-yellow dashed frame holds the whole model; each encoder is a grey rounded box of its layer stack with the repeat count beside it. A separate dashed yellow box on the right is the momentum model.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes, layer boxes tinted by type (blue feed-forward, orange attention); embeddings as rows of small 3-D cubes, the CLS cube yellow.
proposed_highlight: No colour for the contribution; the alignment loss is placed centrally between the encoders, before the fusion encoder, which is the paper's point (align before fuse).
lesson: Put the objective that is the paper's idea where the two towers meet, before the module that fuses them, so the order of the title reads in the drawing.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue NeurIPS 2021 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15).

arrangement.units: one dashed frame for the model; the momentum model a separate box outside it on the right
arrangement.inputs_as: the words 'image input' and 'text input' under each tower
arrangement.losses_at: the contrastive loss between the two towers; ITM and MLM as boxes on top of the fusion encoder

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: image encoder (lower left) and text encoder (lower right) face each other across a central Image-Text Contrastive Loss box that holds their [CLS] cubes and negative queues, placed below and before the multimodal encoder ('align before fuse')

relations.form: the image [CLS] cube and the text [CLS] cube are drawn inside the contrastive-loss box, arrows from each tower's embedding row running straight into it from left and right, with stacked cube rows labelled 'negatives' below

each tower reads bottom to top from its 'image input' / 'text input' label through its Self Attention / Feed forward block to an embedding row of cubes; the text side continues up into the multimodal encoder and its ITM and MLM heads
the image embedding row sends a right-angled line up and right into the multimodal encoder's Cross Attention layer, which sits on top of the text encoder's output
the multimodal encoder's output feeds two head boxes side by side on top, ITM and MLM
a dashed 'hard negatives' arrow rises from the contrastive-loss box to the ITM head, the negatives mined by one objective feeding the other
a separate dashed yellow Momentum Model box outside the main frame on the right, exchanging a blue 'momentum update' arrow and an orange 'momentum distillation' arrow with it

channels.colour: block fill = layer type (orange attention, blue feed-forward); cube colour = token kind (yellow [CLS], green other tokens); arrow fill = momentum direction (blue update, orange distillation) - so blue and orange each carry two meanings, and yellow also fills the Momentum Model box
channels.shape: cubes = embeddings, rounded rectangles = layers grouped in grey stacks with a repeat count (12x, x6), small boxes = objective heads
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow; dashed arrow = hard-negative mining; block arrows = momentum relations (keyed)
channels.frame: dashed cream frame = the trained model; dashed yellow box = the momentum copy outside it

quality.strengths: the paper's idea is placed as geometry - the contrastive loss sits between the two towers and below the fusion encoder, so 'align before fuse' reads from position; the compared representations are drawn as [CLS] cubes inside the loss box, with the negative queue as stacked cube rows
quality.weaknesses: blue and orange are reused for both layer type and momentum arrows, and yellow for both [CLS] cubes and the Momentum Model; the image-to-cross-attention connection is a long right-angled line over the contrastive box; the Momentum Model is a blank box whose relation to each encoder is only two keyed block arrows

insights.structure: Inside one dashed cream container, an image encoder (12x) at lower left and a text encoder (x6) at lower right feed a central Image-Text Contrastive Loss box and a multimodal encoder (x6: self-attention, cross-attention, feed-forward) at upper right topped by ITM and MLM heads; a separate dashed yellow Momentum Model box sits outside on the right.
insights.data: Encoder outputs are rows of small 3-D cubes (green tokens with a yellow [CLS] cube at the end), and the contrastive box shows CLS cubes plus stacked negative cube rows with an ellipsis.
insights.emphasis: Layer sublayers are colour-coded (blue feed-forward, orange attention) and the momentum mechanism is pulled out as a big separate box linked by two fat coloured arrows (blue momentum update, orange momentum distillation) keyed in the right legend.
insights.flow: Bottom-to-top: inputs enter at the bottom, encoders rise to token rows, rows go sideways into the contrastive box and up to the fusion encoder; a dashed arrow carries 'hard negatives' from the contrastive box to ITM.
insights.avoid: The legend and momentum box crowd the right edge and the momentum model is only a labelled box, so which modules it copies is not drawn.
